If you’ve ever searched for a hanky panky recipe, you may have noticed something interesting: the name refers to two completely different but equally iconic creations. One is a legendary pre-prohibition cocktail made with gin, sweet vermouth, and Fernet-Branca. The other is a beloved Midwest recipe a savory, cheesy, meaty spread baked on rye bread and served as a party appetizer.

In this complete informational guide, we’ll explore:

  • The classic hanky panky recipe (cocktail version)

  • The hanky panky sausage recipe (appetizer version)

  • The history of hanky panky cocktail

  • Variations, substitutions, and pro techniques

  • FAQs for both the drink and the food

  • Storage, nutrition, and entertaining tips

Whether you’re looking for a spirit-forward drink or a crowd-pleasing appetizer, this guide covers everything in one place.

What Is a Hanky Panky?

The term “Hanky Panky” refers to:

  1. A classic gin drink created in the early 1900s and featured in the Savoy Cocktail Book.

  2. A retro savory beef and sausage spread baked onto cocktail rye bread slices and served as a holiday finger food.

What Is Hanky Panky Food?

If someone asks “what is hanky panky food?”, they’re referring to a cheesy rye bread appetizer made with:

  • Ground beef

  • Pork sausage

  • Velveeta cheese (or other processed cheese)

  • Spices and Worcestershire sauce

It’s a comfort food snack, often served at holiday entertaining events, potlucks, and Super Bowl appetizers spreads.

What Is the Origin of Hanky Panky Drink?

The origin of hanky panky drink traces back to London’s Savoy Hotel. The cocktail became one of the most famous classic cocktails in the world.

Let’s explore both in detail.

Classic Hanky Panky Cocktail Recipe

The hanky panky cocktail is a bold, elegant herbal liqueur cocktail. It’s a stirred cocktail known for its bittersweet complexity.

Hanky Panky Cocktail Ingredients

  • 1½ oz London dry gin

  • 1½ oz Italian vermouth (sweet vermouth)

  • 2 dashes Fernet-Branca

  • Optional: 1 dash aromatic bitters

  • Orange twist garnish or lemon twist

If you’re researching hanky panky cocktail ingredients, this is the original hanky panky recipe ratio.

Bar Tools and Techniques

To properly prepare this classic gin cocktails staple, you’ll need:

  • Mixing glass

  • Bar spoon

  • Cocktail shaker (optional but traditionally stirred)

  • Strainer

  • Cocktail glass, martini glass, or coupe glass

Understanding stirred vs shaken cocktails is essential here. The Hanky Panky is always a stirred gin cocktail recipe because it is spirit-forward and contains no citrus.

Step-by-Step Instructions

Prep Time

5 minutes

Cook Time

0 minutes

Total Time

5 minutes

Servings

1

Calories

Approximately 180–200

How to Make a Hanky Panky Cocktail

  1. Fill a mixing glass with ice.

  2. Add London dry gin and sweet vermouth.

  3. Add 2 dashes Fernet-Branca.

  4. Stir with a bar spoon for 20–30 seconds.

  5. Strain into a chilled martini glass, coupe glass, or cocktail glass.

  6. Garnish with an orange twist garnish or lemon twist.

This is a true small-batch cocktail with precision and elegance.

Flavor Profile

The Hanky Panky is:

  • A balanced cocktail

  • A spirit-forward drink

  • Features a bold herbal liqueur

  • Offers a bittersweet flavor

  • Contains a distinctive bold herbal flavor

What Does Fernet-Branca Taste Like?

A common FAQ: What does Fernet-Branca taste like?

Fernet-Branca is an Italian amaro liqueur with:

  • Minty bitterness

  • Herbal complexity

  • Medicinal undertones

  • Spiced botanicals

It’s what transforms this from a basic gin and sweet vermouth cocktail recipe into something extraordinary.

History & Origin

Hanky Panky Drink History

The history of hanky panky cocktail begins with Ada Coleman, head bartender at the Savoy Hotel in London.

Classic Hanky Panky Recipe Ada Coleman

Legend says a guest described the cocktail as “that’s the real hanky-panky!” and the name stuck.

It later appeared in the Savoy Cocktail Book, making it one of the most enduring Savoy cocktail book recipes.

Savoy Cocktail Book Hanky Panky

The Savoy Cocktail Book hanky panky version cemented its place among:

  • Classic stirred cocktails

  • Pre-prohibition gin drinks

  • Other icons like:

    • Martini

    • Manhattan

    • Martinez cocktail

    • Negroni

    • Boulevardier

Difference Between Gin Martini and Hanky Panky

A common question: difference between gin martini and hanky panky

Martini Hanky Panky
Gin + dry vermouth Gin + sweet vermouth
Clean & crisp Bittersweet & herbal
Olive or lemon garnish Orange twist garnish
No amaro Contains Fernet-Branca

The Hanky Panky has deeper complexity thanks to the herbal liqueur cocktail structure.

Variations

Cocktails With Fernet-Branca

If you enjoy this drink, try:

  • Fernet + cola

  • Fernet in a Negroni

  • Fernet in a Manhattan

  • Fernet in gin and sweet vermouth cocktails

Substitutions

Can I Substitute Fernet in a Hanky Panky?

Yes, but carefully.

Possible alternatives:

  • Other Italian amaro liqueurs

  • Cynar

  • Montenegro

However, none perfectly replicate the bold herbal flavor of Fernet.

Best Gin for Hanky Panky (Transactional Intent)

If you’re wondering about the best gin for hanky panky, choose:

  • Classic London dry gin

  • High-juniper profile

  • Crisp and botanical

Buy Fernet-Branca Online (Transactional Intent)

You can buy Fernet-Branca online through reputable liquor retailers. Ensure it’s authentic Italian import.

Hanky Panky Sausage Appetizer Recipe

Now let’s explore the other famous hanky panky appetizer recipe.

This retro classic American appetizer is:

  • A savory appetizer

  • A crowd-pleasing appetizer

  • A perfect game day snack

  • A nostalgic retro party snack

Hanky Panky Sausage Recipe Ingredients

Ingredient List

  • 1 lb ground beef

  • 1 lb pork sausage

  • 16 oz Velveeta cheese

  • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce

  • ½ tsp garlic powder

  • ½ tsp onion powder

  • ¼ tsp red pepper flakes

  • 1 package cocktail rye bread slices

Optional variation:

  • Substitute some Velveeta with cream cheese (variation) for extra richness.

Prep & Cook Details

Prep Time

15 minutes

Cook Time

10–12 minutes

Total Time

25–30 minutes

Servings

24–36 pieces

Calories

Approx. 120 per piece

Baking Instructions

How to Make Hanky Panky Appetizer

  1. Brown ground beef and pork sausage in skillet.

  2. Drain excess grease.

  3. Add cubed Velveeta cheese (or other processed cheese).

  4. Stir until melted into a rich and creamy topping.

  5. Add Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, and red pepper flakes.

  6. Spoon mixture onto rye bread slices.

  7. Arrange on baking sheet.

  8. Bake at 375°F for 10–12 minutes until bubbly.

This results in a cheesy rye bread appetizer with a strong umami flavor profile.

Storage & Freezing

Freezer-Friendly Hanky Panky

Yes this is a freezer-friendly appetizer and excellent make-ahead freezer snacks option.

Can You Freeze Hanky Panky Appetizers?

Absolutely.

  1. Assemble on bread.

  2. Freeze unbaked.

  3. Store in airtight container.

  4. Bake directly from frozen.

Perfect for holiday entertaining and easy potluck recipes.

What Bread Is Best for Hanky Panky?

Traditional answer: cocktail rye bread slices.

They create ideal baked rye bread snacks with crispy edges and soft centers.

If searching for cocktail rye bread near me, check bakery sections or specialty bread aisles.

How Long Do You Bake Hanky Panky?

10–12 minutes at 375°F until golden and bubbly.

Can You Make Hanky Panky Ahead of Time?

Yes it’s the ultimate make-ahead appetizer for:

  • Holiday finger foods

  • Hanky panky for Christmas party

  • Super Bowl appetizers

  • Retro gatherings

Variations & Related Appetizers

  • Sausage cream cheese crescent rolls

  • Cheesy party dips

  • Beef and sausage appetizers

  • Easy sausage and cheese appetizer

  • Baked party bites

What Is Hanky Panky Made Of? (Appetizer FAQ)

It’s made of:

  • Ground beef

  • Pork sausage

  • Processed cheese

  • Spices

  • Rye bread

A savory blend forming a savory beef and sausage spread.

Cocktail FAQs

What Is a Hanky Panky Cocktail Made Of?

  • Gin

  • Sweet vermouth

  • Fernet-Branca

Why Is It Called a Hanky Panky?

A guest exclaimed the drink was “the real hanky-panky,” inspiring the name.

Who Invented the Hanky Panky Cocktail?

Ada Coleman at the Savoy Hotel.

Can I Substitute Fernet in a Hanky Panky?

Yes, but other amari change the profile significantly.

Nutrition Information (Appetizer)

Per serving (approximate):

  • Calories: 120

  • Protein: 6g

  • Fat: 9g

  • Carbs: 5g

Pro Tips

Cocktail

  • Always stir never shake.

  • Use high-quality London dry gin.

  • Chill your martini glass beforehand.

Appetizer

  • Drain meat well to prevent soggy bread.

  • For extra spice, increase red pepper flakes.

  • For creamy texture, add cream cheese (variation).

Pairing Ideas

Serve the hanky panky cocktail alongside the hanky panky appetizer for a themed party experience.

For more comfort-food inspiration, check out this crispy indulgent guide: fried-chicken-fries-recipe

It pairs perfectly with retro party food ideas.

Final Thoughts

The hanky panky recipe stands at a unique culinary crossroads:

  • A refined pub-style cocktail

  • A nostalgic comfort food snack

  • A staple among classic American appetizers

  • A pillar of cocktail history

From the Savoy Cocktail Book to Midwest kitchens, it remains iconic.

Whether you’re mixing a small-batch cocktail or baking baked party bites, the Hanky Panky delivers bold flavor, balance, and tradition in every bite and sip.
